name: Segasaki Mio
source:
The woman who runs over Naoki at the beginning of the story. As a matter of fact, she has received an unofficial job offer from a television station, so to cover up the accident, she asks her sister Mao for help, hiding Naoki in the apartment where they live. Despite being the one who caused the accident, without hiding it, she shows a strong feeling of disgust towards Naoki, repeating displeasure​ words and actions, which become the fuel for his anger. After seeing her sister getting banged by him, she interrogates him, however......
